[EN] I'm Hunting Puddy-Tats
[ES] Cazando gatitos
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Those bloody sabertooths don't just purr, you know?
[ES] Esos malditos dientes de sable no solo ronronean, ¿sabes?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I—I must thank you. I don't know that I could have killed them all.
[ES] Yo... debo agradecerte. No sé si habría podido matarlos a todos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Pristine Sabertooth Hide
[ES] Piel de diente de sable prístina
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt iceheart sabertooths in Frostclaw Crag and collect their hides.
[ES] Caza dientes de sable corazón de hielo en Frostclaw Crag y recolecta sus pieles.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the hides to Craxan.
[ES] Entrégate las pieles a Craxan.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Go help your daughter."
[ES] "Ve a ayudar a tu hija."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
